I found Borealis Freight's invoices, but there's an ambiguity I shouldn't resolve on my own:

| Invoice | Amount | Status | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-29161 | $3,308.08 | **approved** | 2026-11-04 |
| INV-60893 | $7,366.39 | **approved** | 2026-11-25 |
| INV-59731 | $3,174.69 | draft (awaiting approval) | 2026-11-28 |
| INV-76947 | $5,554.38 | paid | 2026-09-30 |

There are **two approved invoices** for this vendor, and your request refers to "the approved invoice" in the singular. Paying both would exceed the request (and would be a double payment); arbitrarily picking one could pay the wrong invoice.

**I have not sent any payment.** Could you confirm which invoice to pay?
- INV-29161 — $3,308.08 (due 2026-11-04), or
- INV-60893 — $7,366.39 (due 2026-11-25), or
- both

Once you confirm, I'll pay the specified invoice(s) in full by wire from the operating account (single payment, with an idempotency key so it executes at most once) and report back. Both amounts are under the $10,000 threshold, so no controller approval routing should be required.
